question.text: A PMS debt strategy managing Rs. 1,200 cr AUM must, per SEBI circular, have automated:

answer.text: Order Management System (OMS) for dealing-room controls

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI's PMS rules mandate automated OMS once AUM crosses Rs. 1,000 cr — to enforce audit trail, segregation, best execution. The Trap: Factsheets are compulsory generally; weekly external audit is excessive; auto-dialer is not regulated. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A covers from Distributor side; XXI-B tests PM compliance. Manager's Pro-Tip: Even below Rs. 1,000 cr, automated OMS is best practice — audit trails during SEBI inspections routinely surface dealing-room gaps.
